entry_policy: gold_bloome_v3 closed previous candle EMA9/EMA21 cross with RSI 30..70; next candle open
exit_policy: SL/TP and source strategy RSI exit; no trailing
collision_rule: SL-first when both SL and TP are touched in the same M5 candle
cost_model: actual normalized CSV spread charged half on entry and half on exit, plus $0.50 adverse slippage per side
one_position_rule: bar beginning with active position is consumed; no same-bar re-entry after exit
